target.definition: Number of live births in Japan during July 2026, as counted in the MHLW preliminary monthly vital statistics (including foreign nationals).

inputs.name: annual_births_2025
inputs.description: Total live births in Japan in calendar year 2025, including foreign nationals, as reported in MHLW vital statistics.

provenance.rationale: Recent MHLW data show ~727k births in 2023 and ~720k in 2024; 2025 likely similar or slightly lower.

inputs.name: july_share_of_annual_births
inputs.description: Fraction of annual births that occur in July, based on seasonal patterns in Japan.

provenance.rationale: Japanese birth seasonality shows a peak in summer; July typically accounts for about 8.5% of annual births.

inputs.name: monthly_births_2025
inputs.description: Average number of live births per month in Japan in 2025, including foreign nationals.

provenance.rationale: Derived from annual births 2025 (~720k) divided by 12 months.

inputs.name: july_seasonal_index
inputs.description: Ratio of July births to the average monthly births, capturing summer peak.

provenance.rationale: July tends to have slightly above-average births in Japan; index around 1.02.

inputs.name: births_per_day_july
inputs.description: Average number of live births per day in Japan during July, including foreign nationals.

provenance.rationale: Based on daily birth counts from recent years; roughly 2000 per day in summer months.

inputs.name: japan_population
inputs.description: Total population of Japan in 2026, including foreign nationals.

provenance.rationale: Japan's population is about 123 million in 2025, declining slowly.

inputs.name: annual_birth_rate
inputs.description: Annual live births per person in Japan, including foreign nationals.

provenance.rationale: Crude birth rate around 5.85 per 1000 people, based on recent years.

inputs.name: july_fraction_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of the year represented by July, adjusted for seasonality.

provenance.rationale: July accounts for about 8.5% of annual births due to summer peak.

paths.description: Estimate annual births in 2025 and multiply by July's share of annual births.
Estimate average daily births in July and multiply by the number of days in July.
Use population and crude birth rate to estimate annual births, then apply July fraction.
